user_query: I'm organizing a surprise birthday party for my best friend who loves programming. Can you suggest some programming memes from Reddit to include in the party decorations? Additionally, find some popular posts from Reddit related to birthday party planning for inspiration.

TaskList.description: Query Reddit for programming memes related to birthdays.
Compile a list of relevant programming memes for decorations.
Query Reddit for popular posts about birthday party planning.
Compile a list of popular birthday party planning posts for inspiration.
